name: Prediction-market probability over-extension fade (short the over-priced contract)
rationale: PREDICTION SEGMENT (asset_classes=[prediction], polymarket) — a distinct asset class no inbox spec trades directly (existing polymarket specs use pm_* as CRYPTO features; this trades the prediction contract ITSELF). Mechanism: prediction-market probabilities exhibit favorite-longshot and momentum-overshoot biases — a contract whose implied probability has spiked UP fast and now sits at a rich level often over-extends before resolution and drifts back down as the move is faded. This shorts the over-priced contract: enter short when pm_implied_prob is above a fitted rich level (extended toward certainty but not yet resolved) AND pm_prob_velocity has rolled over (cross_down through ~0 — the upward repricing momentum is exhausting); stop ABOVE entry, take-profit BELOW; exit when velocity turns back up (repricing resumes) or barriers fire. The instrument is the Polymarket contract; pm_book_depth-style capacity is a real constraint (max_position_pct conservative). Distinct from polymarket-positioning-risk-flip and g2-pm-prob-velocity-drift-long (both use pm_* to trade CRYPTO, long). Disconfirmer 1: drop the velocity-rollover arm — if shorting any rich level matches the deflated Sharpe, the momentum-exhaustion timing adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: rich contracts can keep rising to resolution (the favorite wins); if the edge is dominated by resolution losses, the fade is on the wrong side of the longshot bias. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): Polymarket CLOB is PIT; net of CLOB fees + thin depth the fade must clear. tier0 pm_implied_prob + pm_prob_velocity, fresh prod data — low-confidence until OOS; shorting a prediction contract = buying the complementary side.
catalyst: pm_implied_prob at a rich, over-extended level WHILE pm_prob_velocity rolls over (cross_down) — an over-priced contract faded short
